summary: Global Ship Lease, Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing agreements for 10 newbuilding containerships at an aggregate price of ~$917M, with deliveries from 4Q2028 to 1Q2030 financed from balance sheet. The newbuilds are already contracted on multi-year charters. This is an ordinary-course capital expenditure and fleet renewal, not a special-situation event. No board recommendation or advisor is provided. The filing is routine and does not trigger a special-situations classification.
